preconditions.expression: len(parts) == 3 and all(p.isdigit() for p in parts)
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly three space-separated non-negative integers representing the counts of red, green, and blue pixels.
The total number of pixels is strictly positive.

postconditions.expression: result == -1 if (a % 2 == b % 2 == c % 2) else min_fights
postconditions.description: If the parities of all three counts are identical, it is impossible to reach a single color, so output -1. Otherwise, output the minimum number of fights.

postconditions.expression: min_fights == min(a + b, a + c, b + c) if (a % 2 != b % 2) or (a % 2 != c % 2) or (b % 2 != c % 2) else 0
postconditions.description: When possible, the minimum number of fights is the sum of the two smallest counts, which corresponds to eliminating the two minority colors to leave only the majority color (or the color that can be reached via parity shifts).

postconditions.expression: result == 0 if (a == 0 and b == 0) or (a == 0 and c == 0) or (b == 0 and c == 0) else (min_fights if (a % 2 != b % 2) or (a % 2 != c % 2) or (b % 2 != c % 2) else -1)
postconditions.description: If the land is already peaceful (only one color exists), 0 fights are needed. Otherwise, apply the parity check and minimum sum logic.
